0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Chicago Bulls visit the Toronto Raptors, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Bulls a 25% chance to win. Chicago's day-to-day absences are Isaac Okoro, Nic Claxton, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins, while Toronto is without Brandon Ingram, who is out after Achilles surgery, and has Chucky Hepburn, Jakob Poeltl and RJ Barrett listed as day-to-day. In the 2025-26 season series, the Bulls lost 0-3, including a 139-109 loss in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
